title: Export {{what}}
previewHint: Drag on the image to select an area, drag the handles to adjust, or drag inside the frame to move it.
formatTooltip: PNG is lossless. JPEG and WebP are smaller but lossy.
qualityTooltip: Higher means a larger file with fewer compression artefacts.
factorTooltip: Multiply the selected area, or pick “Custom width” to set an exact width.
targetWidthTooltip: Exact output width in pixels; the height follows the aspect ratio of the selection.
pixelatedTooltip: On: pixels stay crisp squares, which is what you want for measured data. Off: the image is smoothed when enlarged.
resetCropTooltip: Reset the selection to the full image.
scalebarTooltip: Draws a scale bar with its length in the bottom right corner.
scalebarUnavailable: This image has no physical scale.
roiTooltip: Draws the selected region of interest.
caption: Caption
captionTooltip: Writes a short caption into the top left corner.
rawTooltip: The brightness slider only affects the display, not the stored data. Tick this to export the unaltered image.
valuesDisplayActive: Exports what you see — brightness included.
valuesRawActive: Exports the unaltered data; the display brightness is ignored.
valuesNoCorrection: No display correction active — both modes are identical.
filenameTooltip: Suggested name. The extension follows the chosen format.
willAskLocation: You will be asked where to save.
willDownload: Goes to your downloads folder (no Electron — restart the app to get a location picker).

style.textTooltip: Free text for the caption. Clear the field to leave the caption out.
style.resetTextTooltip: Back to the automatic caption for this image.
style.scalebarTextFixed: The label follows the scale bar length and cannot be edited.
style.sizeTooltip: Font size relative to the automatic size.
style.colorTooltip: Colour of the text and the bar.
style.boldTooltip: Draw the text in a bold weight.
style.backgroundTooltip: Colour of the plate behind the text.
style.opacityTooltip: Opacity of the backdrop. All the way down means no backdrop at all.
style.dragHint: Drag the block on the preview to move it; drag its corners or edges to resize.
style.lengthTooltip: Force a specific bar length, or let it follow the visible area.

menuExportAll: Export all maps on one sheet…
sizeLimited: reduced to what the browser can encode
menuExportAllPanels: Export all four panels on one sheet…
borderHint: Add empty space around the image, in percent of its size — room for a caption without covering the data.
borderTooltip: Percent of the image on this axis. 50% at most per side.
menuExportBothPanels: Export both panels on one sheet…
scalebarShared: This is the map’s own scale bar — changes here show on the map too. Drag it on the preview to move it.
